cc:Work.dc:title: Shelf - BinTray
cc:Work.dc:description:
A Type tray variant to be used up right with sloped walls in front
Created with Boxes.py (https://boxes.hackerspace-bamberg.de/) Command line: boxes BinTray --sx '50*2' --sh '60*2' --y 90 --front 0.3 --hole_dD 3:7 --thickness 3 --labels 1 --reference 0 Command line short: boxes BinTray --sx --sh --y --front --hole_dD --reference
